capabilities: Create reusable statblock templates with typed fields
Arrange blocks on a configurable canvas grid
Style statblocks with themes, frames and block settings
Calculate values with formulas and rollable dice links
Reuse entries, spells and lists from a compendium
disambiguation: Not an official Atlas VTT plugin; it is an independent community extension that also works without Atlas.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; a full user guide in English and Brazilian Portuguese ships under docs/user-guide/ and can be downloaded from the plugin settings, and the README advises backing up templates and statblock notes before bulk edits or conversions.
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to define a reusable creature or NPC sheet once and then fill in separate values for each individual.

relations.evidence: Forge can use Atlas-supported workflows for dice rolls, roll history, token links, and compatible Resources.
Forge can be used with the separate Statblock Forge: Forked Atlas VTT Compatibility project.
relations.plugin: Statblock Forge: Forked Atlas VTT Compatibility

summary: Template-based builder for tabletop RPG statblocks, with typed fields, a visual canvas layout editor, themes, formulas and optional Atlas VTT dice integration.
